name: What error IS under readout-not-truth: retained update, not distance to an unobserved true pose

statement.latest: \Delta_k:=\delta_R(\hat T_k,\hat T_{k-1})\quad(\text{a directly observed retained difference between consecutive readouts})\quad\text{replaces}\quad e_k:=\operatorname{Log}(\hat T_k^{-1}T^\star)\quad(\text{a distance to an unobserved }T^\star,\text{ a non-readout})
statement.note_ascii: the classical pose-error definition e_k = Log(That_k^-1 T*) requires the unobserved true pose T* -- a non-readout in this workspace's own information-discrete-math discipline (I1-style injection: treating an unread quantity as if it were a number). The readout-native replacement is the retained difference between actual consecutive readouts, Delta_k, which needs no T* at all, not even offline for calibration.

parents.evidence: this is a direct application of the workspace's own root primitive (a retained difference exists) to the specific case of consecutive pose-refinement readouts, replacing a T*-relative definition that the primitive's own discipline forbids treating as a readout.

honest_caveats: This does not claim the classical e_k is 'wrong' in the sense of being mathematically ill-defined -- T* is a coherent mathematical object under a classical-realist stance. It claims that USING it (even only offline, only for calibration) silently imports a non-readout into what this workspace's own standing discipline (EPIS-UNIVERSAL-LENS) requires flagging, and that a genuinely native alternative should be tried before concluding the whole calibration line is exhausted.

A first empirical test of this native construction would still reasonably compare its ACT/HOLD decisions against T*-derived ground truth in the lab (as an external check, not as a calibration input) -- this is a legitimate use of T* as a checker, not as a definitional ingredient, and does not violate the readout-not-truth stance any more than any other falsifiable prediction does.

name: Retained-sensitivity task admissibility: ACT licensed when the task verdict is invariant along data-justified uncertain directions, using the correspondence Hessian's own spectrum (no ground truth anywhere)

statement.latest: \text{Let }H_k\text{ be the real ICP normal-equations Hessian at stage }k\text{, with eigenpairs }(\lambda_j,v_j).\quad\text{A direction }v_j\text{ is data-justified-uncertain if }\lambda_j\text{ is small (near the proven floor);}\quad\text{the data-justified perturbation magnitude along }v_j\text{ is }\propto 1/\lambda_j\ (\text{bounded by weld/M.40.v1's ceiling and, once proven, a floor}).\quad\boxed{\text{ACT}\iff O_T(\hat T_k)=O_T(\hat T_k\oplus\epsilon v_j)\ \text{for every data-justified-uncertain }v_j}
statement.note_ascii: instead of building a calibrated completion set around an assumed true pose (needs T*), perturb the CURRENT estimate along the correspondence Hessian's own low-eigenvalue directions (the directions the DATA ITSELF says are weakly constrained -- directly computable, no ground truth needed) by a magnitude the data itself justifies (inverse eigenvalue, bounded by the proven L_R ceiling), and license ACT only if the task verdict does not change along any such direction. This reuses the real H_k eigen-structure task-conditioned-6d-pose-stop's fourth cycle already computes, but for its actually-valid purpose (identifying weakly-constrained directions) rather than the refuted purpose (a graph-diameter-based decay-rate extrapolation, which needed H_k to have graph structure it does not have).

parents.evidence: uses only retained/observed quantities (H_k's own real eigenstructure), never T*, consistent with the native error definition above

H_k's role here (identifying weakly-constrained directions via its spectrum) is the same structural role L_R plays generally; unlike PROP-DECAY-01 (refuted, run 4), this construction does NOT require H_k to have graph/diameter structure -- it only uses H_k's own eigenvalues directly, which always exist for any real symmetric matrix, sidestepping run 4's exact refutation.
bounds the largest data-justified perturbation direction's inverse-eigenvalue magnitude from below (a small perturbation bound on the best-constrained directions)

honest_caveats: This is a genuinely new construction, not yet implemented or tested as of registration -- Toledo-first: registered before use.

Unlike PROP-DECAY-01, this does NOT need q_formal/M.07's diameter-based floor at all (no graph diameter is needed), which removes that proposal's central structural flaw -- but it still needs its own correctness argument for WHY invariance-under-data-justified-perturbation licenses ACT with any coverage-like guarantee; this is currently a Dr-tier design, not a proven guarantee, and needs the same kind of adversarial scrutiny every prior cycle's hypothesis received before being trusted.

The relationship between 'small eigenvalue direction' and 'actual pose error along that direction' is itself an assumption (weakly-constrained by these correspondences does not automatically mean large true error) -- must be checked empirically, honestly, the same way runs 1-4 checked their own assumptions.

origin.source: Designed 2026-09-09 in response to the founder's instruction to build a new model natively from Toledo's own roots after four calibration-side falsifications. NOT YET IMPLEMENTED OR TESTED.

resistance_evidence.rungs_held: R0 stated; R2 (falsifier reachable and reached) now applied via a real BOP-LMO run.
resistance_evidence.empirical_test_status: Run 5 executed 2026-09-09 (task-conditioned-6d-pose-stop, lab/results/real-bop-lmo-2026-09-09-run5/RESULT.md), predeclaration commit 43954c09eedda7f3802adee6d83b559c836d19e6. This is the first of five real-data cycles on this problem to license ACT at all, and it did so unsafely: ACT fired on 100% of test episodes for all three declared tasks, always at the very first ICP stage (k=0, before any refinement), and was wrong (unsafe ACT) on 92.5-100% of those episodes. This directly refutes this proposal's own honest_caveats item ('the relationship between a small eigenvalue direction and actual pose error along that direction is itself an assumption ... must be checked empirically') at least at this trajectory stage on this backend. Diagnosed cause: the perturbation magnitude this construction produces (bounded by a TRAIN-derived CAP) is systematically smaller than the real coarse-detector initial-pose error, so the invariance test answers a much easier question (is a tiny wobble around the current estimate tolerable) than the one it needs to answer (is the current estimate close to correct). H_k's spectral floor alone, without an absolute residual/noise-scale term (the kind PROP-DECAY-01's own predictor already paired with its contraction rate), is not a safe proxy for pose-estimate uncertainty on this backend. PROP-NATIVE-03 (already registered, parented to this proposal) proposes a persistence/memory-accumulator refinement as one candidate next iteration; a residual-scale-paired variant of this proposal's own perturbation magnitude is another, not yet registered.

name: Memory-accumulated decision rule: ACT licensed only on a persistent streak of task-invariance, not a single-instant check

statement.latest: M_k := M_{k-1} + \mathbb{1}[\text{task verdict invariant under every imagined perturbation at stage } k],\quad M_0:=0,\quad \boxed{\text{ACT} \iff M_k \ge \theta} \text{ (a predeclared persistence threshold)}
statement.note_ascii: M_k accumulates a streak count of consecutive stages where the single-instant imagination+reason check (PROP-NATIVE-02) found the task verdict invariant under every data-justified perturbation; ACT is licensed only once the streak reaches a predeclared threshold theta, not on a single passing instant. A telescoping accumulator in the same idiom as root A2 (FOLD engine).

parents.evidence: adds a persistence/memory requirement on top of the single-instant imagination+reason check, to filter noise-driven false invariance on real, noisy sensor data
M_k is a telescoping accumulator over a binary per-stage readout, the same generic FOLD-engine shape as root A2 (I_+[f](N) = sum_{k<N} f[k])

honest_caveats: Founder framing (verbatim, 2026-09-09): human imagination and reason connect through memory and work simultaneously to decide -- this proposal is the readout-native translation of that observation for this specific problem, not a claim about neuroscience.

A streak-based threshold theta trades responsiveness for noise-robustness; too small a theta gives little protection over the single-instant check (PROP-NATIVE-02) already being tested; too large a theta may prevent ACT from ever firing even when it honestly should, the same failure mode as runs 1-4.
Not yet implemented or tested -- proposed as the next iteration if the single-instant H3 (PROP-NATIVE-01/02, run 5) proves too noise-sensitive to certify reliably.

Empirically refuted 2026-09-09 (run6): on this backend/dataset, the underlying single-instant check (PROP-NATIVE-02) is a near-constant function of stage, so a streak/memory accumulator has nothing to filter and degenerates into a fixed-delay knob. This does not rule out memory/persistence constructions in general -- only that gating a non-noisy signal behind persistence cannot recover safety by itself.

resistance_evidence.rungs_held: R0 stated; R2 (falsifier reachable and reached) now applied via a real BOP-LMO run.
resistance_evidence.empirical_test_status: Run 6 executed 2026-09-09 (task-conditioned-6d-pose-stop, lab/results/real-bop-lmo-2026-09-09-run6/RESULT.md), predeclaration commit 2b4f835982b84c931d538e536278cbce167efeec. A TRAIN-only diagnostic, computed and disclosed BEFORE test.jsonl was opened, found PROP-NATIVE-02's per-stage invariance check evaluates True at every one of 640 TRAIN stage readings (40 episodes x 16 stages, all 3 tasks) -- no toggling exists for a streak counter to filter. This predicted the resetting-streak accumulator M_k (implemented per this entry's own note_ascii reading, not the literal non-resetting-sum LaTeX -- see RATIONALE.md for the disclosed interpretation choice) would degenerate into a fixed-delay knob rather than a genuine noise filter. Confirmed on FINAL TEST: ACT fires deterministically at k=theta-1=3 (theta=4) on 100% of test episodes for all three tasks, unsafe on 80.0-87.5% of them (99/120 task-episode pairs) -- a modest drop from PROP-NATIVE-02's own 92.5-100% attributable only to 3 extra ICP iterations run before commit, not to any noise-filtering property of the memory mechanism. A disclosed follow-up variant additionally scaling the perturbation magnitude by the current observable ICP residual RMSE (addressing PROP-NATIVE-02's own diagnosed root cause directly) produced byte-identical outcomes: the scale factor's dynamic range (~1.15-1.8x, capped at 2x) is roughly two orders of magnitude too small relative to the gap between the perturbation cap and the real coarse-detector initial-pose error to matter. REFUTED as a fix for PROP-NATIVE-02's unsafe-ACT finding: memory/persistence cannot filter a signal that never toggles, and this is exactly what both real BOP-LMO runs (TRAIN and TEST) found on this backend. Marked refuted (not refuted_unsafe): the construction did not make the unsafe outcome WORSE than PROP-NATIVE-02 (it modestly improved the unsafe rate via extra ICP iterations) while still failing to establish safety.
